provision.reason: Realtime pub/sub for high fan-out (replaces Supabase Realtime).

rewrites.reason: Swap supabase.auth.* for the Aiven auth endpoints.
Swap the query builder for typed calls to the Aiven API.
Swap supabase.channel() for the Aiven SSE/Kafka stream.
Stub storage until Aiven object storage exists (gap).

gaps.why: Aiven has no managed S3-compatible object store, so avatar/file uploads have no drop-in target.
gaps.recommendation: Aiven for Object Storage (S3 API). Until then the app keeps Supabase Storage or wires its own bucket.

gaps.why: The Aiven MCP pg_write tool blocks GRANT/CREATE ROLE, so non-owner RLS roles must be created out-of-band.
gaps.recommendation: Allow scoped role/grant statements in the MCP so RLS-complete migrations are fully autonomous.
